title: Settings
description: These preferences stay on this device and apply to sampling and the interface immediately.

experience.title: Interface mode
experience.description: Everyday mode starts with real problems and guided next steps; professional mode keeps every process and metric.
experience.label: Interface mode

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Change CoreRobin menus, guidance, and status text.
language.label: Language

background.title: Background and desktop
background.description: Control how CoreRobin stays available, launches at login, and displays Robin.
background.showDockIconDescription: When off, use the menu bar without occupying the Dock or app switcher
background.launchAtLoginDescription: Start the menu bar service quietly without opening the main window
background.companionShowOnStartupDescription: Show the Robin companion whenever the app starts
background.companionAlwaysOnTopDescription: Stay above other windows; when off, Robin may be covered

sampling.title: System sampling
sampling.description: Shorter intervals react faster and add more sampling overhead.

lowPower.label: Low power
lowPower.description: Every 5 seconds for long background use

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Every second, recommended for daily use

connections.title: Connection refresh
connections.description: Active connections use an independent low-frequency scan.

processView.title: Default process view
processView.description: Used when the process explorer starts or is reset.
processView.label: Default process view

history.title: History
history.description: Save low-frequency aggregate snapshots and alert events without process or connection details.
history.applicationNames: Allow app display names in history
history.applicationNamesHint: Only saves a name when one app clearly explains the pressure. Turning this off removes app names from saved events.

dataPrivacy.title: Data & privacy center
dataPrivacy.description: See what each local dataset contains and control it from one place. CoreRobin does not upload or synchronize these records.

resourceHistory.title: Resource and reminder history
resourceHistory.description: Aggregate health, actions, and watch events. No paths, commands, or network addresses.

connectionHistory.title: Connection history
connectionHistory.description: Optional five-minute aggregates can include remote IPs, domains, ports, and app names.

caches.title: Local product caches
caches.description: Application inventory, cleanup scan, and file-insight results stay on this device.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Only sustained heavy load, real memory pressure, and low disk space interrupt you. CoreRobin follows up once after the problem has stably recovered.

thresholds.title: Resource alert thresholds
thresholds.description: Color levels for CPU, memory, and volume usage; sustained High readings create alerts.

watchRules.title: Application watch and reminder rules
watchRules.description: Watch a chosen app and notify once when a metric stays above its condition; a recovered rule can notify again later.
watchRules.notificationHint: Enable desktop notifications and grant permission before rules can send system reminders.
watchRules.backgroundSampling: Background process checks run every {{seconds}} seconds while an enabled rule needs them.

about.title: About & support
about.description: Check the version, get help, and manage the data CoreRobin keeps on this computer.
about.versionDescription: Check, download, and install the latest stable version directly in CoreRobin.
about.updateError: Updates cannot be checked right now. Try again later.
about.upToDate: You are up to date with v{{version}}
about.updateReady: The update is installed. Restart CoreRobin to finish.
about.updateInstallError: The update could not be installed. Your current version is unchanged; try again later or view the release notes.
about.helpDescription: Open the public guide, or review what is included before reporting a problem.
about.diagnosticsDescription: Copy basic runtime details that help troubleshoot a problem.
about.diagnosticsPrivacy: Hostnames, process names, file paths, network addresses, and history values are excluded by default.
about.clearDescription: Clear preferences, history, alerts, action records, and the space-scan cache.
about.clearConfirm: This cannot be undone. CoreRobin will clear on-device data and restart; system permissions such as login startup are not silently removed.

one.title: Choose the view that suits you
one.description: Everyday mode gives stable conclusions and a next step. Professional mode keeps full metrics, process, and network evidence. Switch at any time.
one.note: Both modes share the same on-device state and reach the same conclusions.

two.title: Quietly stays available after the window closes
two.description: CoreRobin remains in the menu bar with low-frequency sampling. The menu panel and Robin companion share one stable state.
two.note: Pause, open settings, or quit completely from the menu bar.

three.title: Permissions are optional and purposeful
three.description: Notifications, Robin companion, and launch at login are optional. Full Disk Access only makes a space-cleanup scan more complete.
three.note: Without it, accessible areas can still be scanned. CoreRobin does not request it during this guide.
